_note: Front (full-strength / Ready) side of every Italy '43 counter, read at 2.4x-12x zoom from counters-fronts.jpg (crops and scripts in fz/). photoPos = row/column in the photo (r0 = the partial top row of 6, r1-r15 = full rows of 10, left to right). printed = strength line as printed: superscript tank rating as '4³-3-5', yellow-box TD rating as '2[3]-2-5', ASU as 'S (1) 5'. For ASUs a=0, d=1 (the parenthesised defence). quality: elite = defence in a red box, low = defence in a white box, null = unboxed. sp = boxed stacking value, null where none is printed. corner = lower-right number (start hex or arrival turn); 'triangle' = a pale triangle is printed there instead (unit begins reduced); null = nothing printed. cornerBox = colour of the box behind the corner number (blue/black) or null. differences compare with data/italy43/oob.json; notes hold other observations.
